title: run-lookup
description: Output of `analyst runs show --json`: the provenance-checked run report of a project, its codegraph usage summary and its neutral analytics events.

project.description: Absolute project directory that was inspected.

status.description: found: a trusted report is returned; rejected: a report exists but belongs to another project, session or provider; missing: there is no report.

path.description: Report file that was selected, or null when none was.

report.description: The run report object, or null.

codegraph.description: Codegraph usage summary of the report (calls, ops, by_op), or null without a report.

events.description: Validated neutral analytics events of the project, optionally of one session.
